description:
We are Nile Detectives, building an interactive climate dashboard for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We use advanced statistics (Modified Mann-Kendall, Ruptures) and multi-persona UX for farmers, researchers, and kids.
  
We are looking for:
Frontend Developer (Streamlit/React)
  
Data Analyst (NASA POWER API & modeling)
  
Science Communicator/Designer
  
Join us to make climate data accessible for everyone!
